title: Onboard aurora-slim-7b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
description: This PR adds onboarding files for aurora-slim-7b v1.0, including model metadata, performance profiles for common sequence length buckets, and automation to generate changelog/release notes entries when new models are registered. Motivation: aurora-slim-7b is a community model we want to offer in the catalog with optimized inference profiles for low-latency use cases and automated changelog entries to keep the registry docs in sync. Changes include: (1) model metadata JSON (architecture, tokenizer, params, recommended quantization), (2) performance profiles generated from perf-lab runs (p50/p95 latency, throughput, memory) for 128/512/2048 tokens, (3) a small script and CI job that appends a changelog entry into models/CHANGELOG.md when onboarding is merged, and (4) unit tests and integration checks for profile validity. Checklist: [x] metadata schema validated against registry spec; [x] perf runs reproducible (perf-lab commit hashes referenced); [x] changelog automation includes author/date/summary template; [x] docs snippet for the model added to docs/; [ ] follow-up: schedule canary on Dedicated for 24h. Related Linear: ENG-11234 (model onboarding flow), ENG-11890 (perf profiles standardization).
